name: std::atomic_flag::notify_all
intro:
Performs atomic notifying operations.

Unblocks all threads blocked in atomic waiting operations (i.e. wait()) on *this, if there are any; otherwise does nothing.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: This form of change-detection is often more efficient than simple polling or pure spinlocks.

examples.title: Practical example
examples.input: The reader waits until the worker sets a flag.
